notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
[p][b][i]Hi all, this patch is updating the submarine and provides some new toys. Hope you enjoy.[/i][/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]1.0.0.4 Qualitiy-Of-Dive improvements:[/b]      

[i][b]Technical stuff:
[/b][/i][/p][p][b][i] [/i][/b][b]- Target Collection, Funny Valves & Performance[/b] 
- Fixed damaged valves pointing in funny directions (just cosmetic issue).
- Some minor performance improvements and back up stuff. Nothing you should notice during gameplay.         

[i][b]Gameplay stuff:[/b][/i]   [/p][p]   [/p][p][b]- Submarine Typ II - Periscope - Ballast Tanks - New Layout[/b] 
The engineers improved a lot of the submarines layout. So much that it resulted in a new type. You will now find a new bridge, rudder and engine section. Along with this we got new toys on board. A periscope to better understand your surroundings. Ballast tanks for going down or up without constantly pressing the "push" buttons (use them carefully, as they are not effected by the STOP button). And some emergency rudders in the front and back, in case you got traped and don't want to use the sub-port. The Cofffee is now located at the bridge and we got a little more space in every section.  [/p][p][/p][p][i]A huge thanks to the discord on this. I think it is a way better submarine now than ever before.[/i]   

[b]- Save & Load[/b] 
The way this works is the following: Once the submarine is closed, everyone is able to save the current dive situation with cave, sub-health and sub-position. Loading is exclusive to the host of a session. This way it is possible to return with more or less players and a new set up to a savegame, as the loading takes place after the invite. So feel free to save a difficult situation and come back later with more people to show that cave who is in charge here.   

[b]- More Sexy ESC Menu[/b] 
Still not the most beautiful, it is now improved with numbers to the sliders. You can type your values for FOV, sound and brightness now. We now also got some icons for cups and hats and stuff.  

[b]- Manual[/b] 
I created a manual for everyone who wants to have some insights of the games mechanics. It can be found on the right side of the steam product page. Let me know if you want to read more there. I think it gives a good idea on how things work in S.O.C. but I am obvoiusly biased.

[b]- New SR room[/b] 
In preparation for the full release, the SR room in the base is now updated. Everyone can now also see their own records of the caves they successfully mastered on the big wall there.  

[b]- New Hats? Not Yet. Make A Wish.[/b]  
So this is not a game about unlocking hats. So I decided I will just add every hat that is wished for in the discord to the game (one per member). So if you would like to see a specific hat, just let me know on discord. I will see what I can do for you.    [/p][p][/p][p]That's it for now. There is still some stuff I would like to see before the full release but this game is getting close to its final version. Some tweaking and maybe some additonal viewports to the sub and everything is ready. Let me know what you think and feel free to join the discord. Link is on the store-page.    [/p][p] [/p][p][i]As always, hope you like that and let me know what you think in the comments.[/i]
 
[b]Thx to everyone for diving and have a nice day, [i]Dev
[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
[p]Hi all, this patch is adding a lot of new little things. From just cosmetic features to new game-mechanics.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]1.0.0.3 Qualitiy-Of-Dive improvements:[/b]  

[i]Technical stuff:[/i]   
- Empty Cup Bug: fixing a bug where you couldn't refill your cup
- Back Light Bug: fixing a bug where the back light in the submarine would not switch back to white
- Target Collect Bug: Increased the range of backup-target-interaction to easily sync target activation   


[i]Gameplay stuff:[/i]    One returning suggestion from the divers was to have a little more info for navigation and general direction. Just to get a better understanding of where to actually head the sub. Also mentioned more than once, the wish for more customization and a little more to do on the sub itself while diving. So here are some first steps to improve the diving experience into that direction:  [/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Added a 3D realtime map[/b] to the bridge of the submarine with 2 zoom steps. Your position is always the middle. The cave is shown transparent around and the target is a red dot. That should help to plan your next move with more confidence. Also note: the submarine light (red, blue, white) can help to see things better on that map.  [/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Collision events[/b] are now a thing. The submarine is now equipped with valves. In the event of an collision, these may open up to release pressure from the pipes to prevent them from bursting. This also may affects some operational systems within the sub like buttons, lights or screens. So ensure to check and close them again after a collision.  [/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Hats[/b] can now be put on or off. To introduce them we start with a captains hat and a black hat. They can be switched to your likings at any time in the ESC menu. So anybody can be a captain now.  [/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Submarine customization[/b] can now be found on the way to the submarine. In this demo you can now choose between some preset colors for outer hull, inner hull and the pipes. Feel free to mix and match as you like. Everybody can also set a name for the sub in the ESC menu, making sinking even more painful, as your submarine now got a name :, (        (the customization colors will be expanded in the full release version)  [/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Reworked ESC menu. [/b]The ingame ESC menu is now reworked to better scale with screens and is re-arranged to fit the main menu better.   [/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Improved Info Screen[/b]. We now see X, Y, Z coordinates that are shown as such and distance is now in meter. This should help to easier define positioning and aerial awareness.

- [b]New Sounds.[/b] The Engine features now a more mechanical charactered sound and the target tanks also got a new layer of sound to better match their "volume".  [/p][p][/p][p]- Also fixed some typos here and there (pretty sure there are still some left) and updated the tutorial level. [/p][p] [/p][p][i]As always, hope you like that and let me know what you think in the comments.[/i]
 
[b]Thx to everyone for diving and have a nice day, [i]Dev
[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
[p]Hi all, this patch implements some feedback and wishes from the community, as well as some further improvements. 

[b]1.0.0.2 Qualitiy-Of-Dive improvements:[/b] 
[i]Technical stuff:[/i] 

- More FPS for everybody. Mainly through light/shadow, collision and remesh work, we now have a much better overall performance. So the only thing that should dive now is the sub and not your FPS. I also did some compatibility work, which leads to "recombining" the default and performance edition into one from now on. (you can still access the older versio via the beta-branch if you want). 

- Addressed a bug where a crew reported they couldn't activate the target-collection. This is now taken care of with a backup mechanic that should prevent that from happening entirely. 


[i]Gameplay stuff:[/i] 
For this patch I addressed the accessibility for new players and little tweaks here and there: 

- Added a main menu. This alone should make it more obvious that this game has a tutorial area. It also features some tips if you feel like staying in the main menu a little longer. It also features some graphic settings, which changes you can see directly in the background like detail, light and stuff. 

- Added a little screen message when you reached your cofffee treshould. 

- Added a little screen message that shows when you try to swap cups but haven't unlocked any so far. 

- Added a little message on the first cofffee-machine to welcome new divers with useful info. 

- Added and adjusted some tutorial texts in the tutorial area. 

- Added "Tap-Cofffee". You can find it in the WC room. 

- Optimized collision inside the submarine so it's now harder to get stuck within it (should be almost impossible but you never know). 

That's it for this patch. If you would like to dive deeper into development with ideas or wishes, or maybe just a casual convo, feel free to join my small discord and let's have a chat there. It can be found linked on my steam-developer page. 


N[i]ext patch: 
[/i]Planning to launch this within the next 4 weeks, it will implement new sounds, and even some tracks. I am also working on some hit-events where you actually have something to do when you hit the cave wall. As you may noticed, I removed the sparking effect when the sub hits the wall, but they will return soon. In addition to that I would like to implement a submarine-color customization. So yeah, let me know what you think here in the comments or on discord. Always happy to get in touch. 

[b]Thx to everyone for diving and have a nice day, [i]Dev[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
Hi all, 

this patch implements some feedback and wishes from the community.

[b]1.0.0.1 Qualitiy-Of-Dive improvements:[/b]

[i]Technical stuff:[/i]
- Added a VSync activation/deactivation option
- Added a Framelock activation/deactivation option

[i]Gameplay stuff:[/i]
- Added a device next to the target-collection button, that gives you a "shortcut" option on your way back. The "[i]A.B.D.[/i]" . Once you reached and collected the target in a cave, you can now end the dive successfully at that point by sacrificing 25% of your total mission reward by pressing the A.B.D. button. So you don't get as much XP but are also earlier done with a cave. Do as you like.
